basis: Fuel arithmetic for /gas. Heat rates are EIA's 2024 average tested full-load heat rates for natural-gas units by prime mover (Electric Power Annual Table 8.2, weighted by net summer capacity); real units run hotter at part load, so fuel figures here are a floor, not a bill. Heat content converts MMBtu to cubic feet.
